001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.PersonImportance;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StarSystemAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Ranks;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithBarEvent;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
017
018public class LuddicPilgrimTransport extends HubMissionWithBarEvent {
019
020        //graphics/icons/missions/luddic_pilgrim_transport.png
021        public static float MISSION_DAYS = 75f;
022        public static float MIN_VALUE = 10000f;
023        public static float MAX_VALUE = 20000f;
024        public static float PROB_RICH = 0.5f;
025        
026        public static enum Stage {
027                TRANSPORT,
028                COMPLETED,
029                FAILED,
030        }
031        
032        public static enum Variation {
033                RICH,
034                POOR,
035        }
036        
037        
038        protected MarketAPI source_market;
039        protected StarSystemAPI destination_system;
040        protected SectorEntityToken destination_entity;
041        protected int quantity;
042        protected String destination_shrine;
043        protected String visit_target_name;
044        protected String visit_target_name_short;
045        protected Variation variation;
046        
047        @Override
048        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
049                // if already accepted by the player, abort
050                if (!setGlobalReference("$lpt_ref", "$lpt_inProgress")) {
051                        return false;
052                }
053                
054                //genRandom = Misc.random;
055                
056                //if (Factions.PIRATES.equals(createdAt.getFaction().getId())) return false;
057                
058                source_market = createdAt;
059                
060                // let's just whitelist core worlds. Should be based on places that plausibly have a significant/interesting Luddic population
061                // eh, I added a bunch more -dgb
062                if ( !( source_market.getId().equals("chicomoztoc") ||
063                                source_market.getId().equals("mazalot") ||
064                                source_market.getId().equals("ilm") ||
065                                source_market.getId().equals("volturn") ||
066                                source_market.getId().equals("jangala") ||
067                                source_market.getId().equals("epiphany") ||
068                                source_market.getId().equals("cibola") ||
069                                source_market.getId().equals("madeira") ||
070                                source_market.getId().equals("chalcedon") ||
071                                //source_market.getId().equals("tartessus") ||
072                                source_market.getId().equals("hesperus") ||
073                                source_market.getId().equals("fikenhild") ||
074                                source_market.getId().equals("athulf") ||
075                                source_market.getId().equals("orthrus") ||
076                                source_market.getId().equals("yesod") ||
077                                source_market.getId().equals("yama") ||
078                                source_market.getId().equals("new_maxios") ||
079                                source_market.getId().equals("ailmar") ||
080                                source_market.getId().equals("tigra_city") ||
081                                source_market.getId().equals("salamanca") ||
082                                source_market.getId().equals("suddene")) ) {
083                        
084                        return false;
085                        }
086                
087                if (rollProbability(PROB_RICH)) {
088                        variation = Variation.RICH;
089                        float value = MIN_VALUE + getQuality() * (MAX_VALUE - MIN_VALUE);
090                        value *= 0.9f + genRandom.nextFloat() * 0.2f;
091                        setCreditReward((int)(value * 0.5f), (int)(value * 0.7f));
092                } else {
093                        variation = Variation.POOR;
094                }
095                
096                if (barEvent) {
097                        setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
098                        setGiverPost(Ranks.POST_PILGRIM);
099                        //setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
100                        setGiverImportance(PersonImportance.VERY_LOW); // irrelevant anyway.
101                        setGiverFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH);
102                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
103                }
104                
105                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
106                if (person == null) return false;
107                
108                
109                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$lpt_ref")) {
110                        return false;
111                }
112                
113                setRepFactionChangesNone();
114                setIconName("campaignMissions", "luddic_pilgrim_transport");
115                
116                // Maybe handle non-"public" shrines later.
117                destination_shrine = pickOne("gilead", "beholder_station", "tartessus");
118                
119                if (destination_shrine.equals("gilead"))
120                {
121                        visit_target_name = "Shrine of Gilead";
122                        visit_target_name_short = "shrine";
123                        destination_system = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("canaan");
124                        destination_entity = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("gilead").getPlanetEntity();
125                        //.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$lpt_targetMarket", true);
126                        if (destination_entity == null) return false;
127                        if (!destination_entity.getMarket().getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) return false;
128                        
129                        makeImportant(Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("gilead"), "$lpt_target", Stage.TRANSPORT);
130                }
131                else if (destination_shrine.equals("tartessus"))
132                {
133                        visit_target_name = "Cathedral of Holy Exodus";
134                        visit_target_name_short = "cathedral";
135                        destination_entity = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("tartessus").getPlanetEntity();
136                        destination_system = destination_entity.getStarSystem();
137                        
138                        //.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$lpt_targetMarket", true);
139                        if (destination_entity == null) return false;
140                        if (!destination_entity.getMarket().getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) return false;
141                        
142                        makeImportant(destination_entity, "$lpt_target", Stage.TRANSPORT);
143                }
144                else if (destination_shrine.equals("beholder_station"))
145                {
146                        visit_target_name = "Shrine of Kumari Aru";
147                        visit_target_name_short = "shrine";
148                        destination_system = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("kumari kandam");
149                        for (SectorEntityToken beholder_station : destination_system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.LUDDIC_SHRINE)) {
150                                destination_entity = beholder_station;
151                                break;
152                        }
153                        makeImportant(destination_entity, "$lpt_target", Stage.TRANSPORT);
154                }
155                
156                if (!setEntityMissionRef(destination_entity, "$lpt_ref")) {
157                        return false;
158                }
159                
160                
161                
162                setStartingStage(Stage.TRANSPORT);
163                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
164                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
165                
166                setStageOnMemoryFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, destination_entity, "$lpt_completed");
167        //      setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, "lpt_completed");
168                setNoAbandon();
169                setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null);
170                
171                
172                
173                //setCreditRewardWithBonus(CreditReward.VERY_LOW, (int) (value * 0.5f));
174                
175                return true;
176        }
177        
178        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
179                //set("$lpt_destinationShrine", destination_shrine);
180                set("$lpt_barEvent", isBarEvent());
181                set("$lpt_reward", Misc.getWithDGS(getCreditsReward()));
182                
183                set("$lpt_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
184                set("$lpt_heOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe());
185                set("$lpt_hisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer());
186                set("$lpt_himOrHer", getPerson().getHimOrHer());
187                set("$lpt_HeOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(1));
188                set("$lpt_HisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHisOrHer().substring(1));
189                set("$lpt_HimOrHer", getPerson().getHimOrHer().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHimOrHer().substring(1));
190                
191                if( variation == variation.POOR)
192                        set("$lpt_wealth", "poor");
193                else set("$lpt_wealth", "rich");        
194                
195                set("$lpt_personName", getPerson().getNameString());
196                set("$lpt_systemName", destination_system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort());
197                set("$lpt_entityName", destination_entity.getName());
198                set("$lpt_sourceName", source_market.getName());
199                set("$lpt_visitTargetName",visit_target_name);
200                set("$lpt_visitTargetNameShort",visit_target_name_short);
201
202                //if (destination_entity.m)
203                //set("$lpt_marketOnOrAt", destination_entity.getOnOrAt());
204                
205                set("$lpt_dist", getDistanceLY(destination_entity));
206        }
207        
208        @Override
209        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
210                float opad = 10f;
211                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
212                if (currentStage == Stage.TRANSPORT) {
213                        info.addPara("Transport a small party of Luddic pilgrims to " + destination_entity.getName() + 
214                                        " in the " + destination_system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort() + ".", opad,
215                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(quantity));
216                        
217                        //info.addPara("The pilgrims will expect to arrive at the shrine within " + MISSION_DAYS + " days.", opad);
218                        info.addPara("The pilgrims will expect to arrive at the shrine within %s days.", opad,
219                                        h, "" + (int) MISSION_DAYS);
220                }
221        }
222
223        @Override
224        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
225                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
226                if (currentStage == Stage.TRANSPORT) {
227                        info.addPara("Transport a small party of Luddic pilgrims to " + destination_entity.getName() + 
228                                        " in the " + destination_system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), pad, tc,
229                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(quantity));
230                        return true;
231                }
232                return false;
233        }       
234        
235        @Override
236        public String getBaseName() {
237                return "Luddic Pilgrim Transport";
238        }
239        
240}
